metaDescription: FizzleSMP is a curated Minecraft 1.21.1 Fabric modpack built for multiplayer survival — RPG classes, overhauled combat, massive worldgen, technology, and community features.
ogDescription: Forge your path. Master your craft. Shape the world. A curated Fabric modpack for friends who want more from Minecraft.

hero.lede: Forge your path. Master your craft. Shape the world.
hero.sub: A handcrafted multiplayer survival experience built for friends who want more from their world — without losing what makes Minecraft feel like home. Minecraft 1.21.1 on Fabric.

sections.title: What makes FizzleSMP different
sections.lede: Every mod is here for a reason. Nothing is filler.

items.title: A World Worth Exploring
html: Nearly a hundred biomes reshape the Overworld with dramatic cliffs, lush valleys, and forgotten ruins. The Nether, End, and hidden dimensions reward the bold. Every dungeon and temple has been rebuilt from the ground up.

items.title: Choose Your Path
html: Train as a Wizard, Paladin, Rogue, Warrior, or Archer through a full RPG class system. Build industrial empires with Tech Reborn and Oritech. Hunt legendary weapons from Arsenal. Enchant with Meridian's five-stat system.

items.title: Combat That Feels Alive
html: Directional swings, combat rolls, legendary weapons with passive abilities, and enemies that grow tougher the longer your world survives. Boss encounters are designed for groups.

items.title: Built for Community
html: Proximity voice chat. Land claims. Per-player loot so every chest feels like yours. Waystones to stay connected across a massive world. Seasons that change the world together.

sections.title: Mod categories
sections.lede: Over 100 mods organized into eight categories, each serving a clear purpose.

items.title: World Generation
html: Biomes, structures, dimensions, and terrain — the foundation that makes every journey unique.

items.title: Combat & RPG
html: Overhauled combat mechanics, class systems, weapons, boss encounters, and gear progression.

items.title: Gameplay
html: Core mechanics, technology, magic, farming, seasons, and content that defines the FizzleSMP experience.

items.title: Social & Community
html: Voice chat, social presence indicators, and community features that bring players together.

items.title: Protection & Security
html: Land claims, anti-grief tools, and server protection that keep builds safe.

items.title: Utility & QoL
html: Minimap, HUD, inventory management, and quality-of-life improvements that smooth the experience.

items.title: Admin & Management
html: Server administration, moderation, and management tools for operators.

items.title: Performance
html: Sodium, Lithium, Noisium, and the full optimization stack that keeps frame rates high and load times low.

sections.title: Powered by Concord
sections.lede: FizzleSMP includes all four mods from the Concord collection — independent overhauls of vanilla systems that light up together.

items.title: Tribulation
html: The world pushes back the longer and farther you survive. Learn more →

items.title: Meridian
html: Enchanting becomes a system you build toward, not a slot machine. Learn more →

items.title: Mercantile
html: Villagers become people you have a history with. Learn more →

items.title: Prosperity
html: Every chest is worth opening, for every player who finds it. Learn more →

Under the hood, a full performance stack — Sodium, Lithium, Noisium, FerriteCore, ModernFix, and more — keeps frame rates high and load times low, even with over 100 mods packed in. The server runs Fabric on bare metal, updated in place via packwiz — no wipe-and-recreate.
